name: date-stamp
title: Date/time stamp card
description: Red match-cut stamp for a date or timestamp, slams in and slide-fades out. Amber variant available. Being superseded by popfig for new date reveals per owner 2026-08-16 guidance, but still valid for match-cut beats.

name: lower-third
title: Location + time lower-third
description: Bottom-left location label over a time chip, the standard scene-setting lower-third used across every episode.

name: popup-chip
title: Frosted glass popup stat chip
description: Backdrop-blurred rounded chip for a headline stat with an optional fine-print subline. Freely positioned (inline left/top).

name: source-label
title: Source/credit label
description: Small bottom-right (or repositioned) credit chip identifying the footage source, e.g. broadcaster or agency.

name: quote-card
title: Pull-quote card
description: Centered italic quote with an amber attribution line beneath it. Has a glasscard variant for text directly over moving footage.

name: glass-panel
title: Glass card treatment
description: The one approved treatment for any text block sitting directly over moving footage: blurred dark glass panel, no bare text. Combine with quotecard or other text blocks.

name: name-card
title: Full-width namecard
description: Centered speaker/subject identification card: bold name line over an italic amber subtitle (title/role).

name: dispatch-card
title: Radio/dispatch two-line card
description: Monospace headline line (radio call, dispatch code) over a smaller grey-blue label line, centered mid-frame.

name: abril-figure-popup
title: Abril figure date/stat popup
description: Large eerie red display-face popup for a date or standalone figure, mid-screen, no background block. Owner's current default for date/figure reveals (2026-08-16), replacing .stamp. Amber variant available.

name: blackout
title: Chapter blackout
description: Full-frame hard black cut used for act/chapter boundaries. Duration is the editorial decision (owner table: 0.6-0.9s chapter break, 1.0-1.3s dramatic punctuation, 1.5s+ dead air) — this snippet is just the plate.

name: polaroid-portrait
title: Polaroid victim/witness portrait
description: Centered rotated polaroid-style photo card with a serif caption line and italic detail sub-line, used for match-cutting to spoken names (e.g. victim identification).

name: pillarbox-blurfill
title: Letterboxed still pillarbox pattern
description: For a still whose aspect ratio doesn't fill 1920x1080: a contain-fit sharp image over a blurred cover-fit duplicate of the same image, so there are never bare black bars. Requires the wirePillarboxBlurfill() DOM-clone helper from helpers.js run once before the timeline builds.

name: dim-scrim
title: Dim / heavy-dim scrim
description: Flat dark overlay to knock back a busy background plate so foreground text/cards read cleanly. Two strengths.

name: archival-stock-grade
title: Archival/stock look filter
description: Per-clip CSS filter (not the #grade overlay) that ages archival photos or desaturates stock footage to match the episode's unified look. Applied directly to the clip/image element, not the composition.

name: film-layer
title: Film layer: grade + vignette + grain + dust
description: The whole-episode look layer: soft-light color grade tint (per-episode, e.g. cold/flood or warm/fire), radial vignette, seeded canvas grain, and drifting dust specks. grain.js is vendored per-episode and driven by filmLayer(tl, DUR) after the composition's GSAP timeline exists.
source_episode: assets/styles/grain.js (canonical); #grade values from ep6 (cold) and ep5 (warm)
